catalogue_requests.reason: A read-only facility monitor needs a capability, and no catalogue read class fits: cap.sensing.read.v1 returns the fields a caller names, which one native Signal get cannot serve, and the measure classes (cap.measure.current.v1) need a fixed unit the source does not state for PV S-DCCT:CurrentM. The extension reads the storage-ring current through the proven current.get with use_monitor=False and has no input and no effect.

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/bcda-aps__apstools --backend fake; the evidence is contract_checked and never an MHS-Device level. No IOC, Channel Access network, ophyd, pyepics or apstools code was imported or run, and the hardware backend was never opened. Authored by claude-opus-5-5 (a model, not a human) as the OphydDriver exemplar; reviewed_by is null and no human reviewed it. Entry symbol: the card's scanned synApps record classes (UserScalcoutN, UserCalcoutN, UserAverageN, SscanRecord, SubRecord) fail the Ophyd source proof (no direct Components, reflection in the module, DynamicDeviceComponent), so a registry override (MHS/registry/overrides/labs.json) sets the entry symbol to apstools.devices.aps_machine:ApsMachineParametersDevice (apstools/devices/aps_machine.py:38). Covered: the seven EpicsSignalRO Components current, machine_status, operating_mode, shutter_status, shutters_open, fill_number and orbit_correction, each a get-only signal_bindings entry (profile classic_epics_ro_v1, get(use_monitor=False)) that gate G7 proves at its Component line, and one observational capability x-cap.bcda-aps.ring_current.v1 over the proven current.get. NOT COVERED: the aps_cycle Component (ApsCycleDM, a soft signal computed from a local schedule file) and the operator_messages sub-Device (eight string PVs), which are not direct EpicsSignalRO Components of the class; the inUserOperations property, whose machine_status.get() does not force a fresh read. Units: the clone states no engineering unit for any PV, so the numeric fields carry none; the IOC's EGU is the unit at a deployment. Types: shutters_open, fill_number and orbit_correction are served as numbers; the source does not state their PV types, and a PV of another type fails output validation instead of being coerced. Safety: data only, risk R0 (the card's floor); no write, no Status and no native stop are declared because the Device actuates nothing; an e-stop is the endpoint's software latch (the extension capability is refused until an operator reset, mhs.resource.read stays available). A PV read timeout (ophyd ReadTimeoutError, a TimeoutError) is reported as MHS.OUTCOME.UNKNOWN with no value. Gate notes: G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no limit exists to probe, CL2). The hardware factory native.py imports apstools.devices.aps_machine, whose package initializer imports every apstools device module; it builds the Device under an operator-given name and waits for the seven bound Signals in turn, each for at most connection_timeout_s (at most 60 s, so up to 420 s in all); it creates but never reads or waits for the aps_cycle soft signal and the eight operator_messages channels (OPS:message1 to OPS:message8); it has never been run. Licence: the card and the lock say BSD-3-Clause, the registry's reading of LICENSE.txt, but the clone declares LicenseRef-ANL-Open-Source-License (pyproject.toml:24) and LICENSE.txt is UChicago Argonne's own open-source licence; a registry override makes the card say publish_review required, so publication needs the owner's licence decision.
